name: Pokecut
description_en:
Pokecut is a browser AI photo/design service with background removal/change, enhancement, object replacement, image extension and batch preparation. The batch page groups repeated background/quality/size work into one job, with selected images then taken into its canvas for individual refinement.

It fits preparing consistent visual assets when users inspect AI results and plan conditions. Web Premium benefits and purchased credits currently do not transfer to the mobile app. The current website price matrix distinguishes Free, SE, Pro and Ultra and separates recurring credits from selected tools advertised as unlimited.
description_zh:
Pokecut是浏览器AI照片/设计服务，包含去/换背景、增强、对象替换、扩图及批量准备。批量页把重复背景/质量/尺寸任务组织为一批，重点图片再进画布单独细化。

它适合检查AI结果及套餐条件后制作统一素材。网页Premium及购买点当前不能转用于移动App，网页矩阵区分Free、SE、Pro、Ultra，并把循环点数与部分宣传无限的工具分开。

core_features.explanation_en: The current batch page supports up to 50 images, enhancement/cutout/background/size tasks and packaged downloads.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前批量页支持最多50图、增强/抠图/换背景/尺寸任务及打包下载。

core_features.explanation_en: SE consumes credits for standard tools; Pro/Ultra advertise selected standard tools as unlimited while retaining AI pools.
core_features.explanation_zh: SE标准工具耗点，Pro/Ultra对部分标准工具宣传无限，同时仍有AI点池。

core_features.explanation_en: Payment terms distinguish website subscription/one-time credits from app-store purchases and restrict transfer.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付款条款区分网站订阅/一次性点与应用商店购买，并限制跨平台转用。

sections.title_en: Prepare one repeated task before individual hero edits
sections.title_zh: 先完成重复任务再单独细修重点图
sections.en:
The [actual batch page](https://www.pokecut.com/batch-edit) accepts JPEG/JPG/PNG/WebP/BMP and describes up to 50 images. Upload a set with the same goal, choose enhancement, removal, background change or crop/resize, process and review the set, then download a package. Important images can be opened in Unlimited Canvas for deeper lighting, retouch or AI scene work.

Enhancement modes include Standard, Portrait and Text; cutout modes include General, Head & Face and Text. Replacement backgrounds can use a solid/custom color, uploaded image or template. These are workflow descriptions, not a guarantee that every image meets marketplace policies or that “up to 30%less prep” is a measured outcome. Compare difficult edges/text/product colors and spot-check every source type before a large delivery. No batch was uploaded or processed.
sections.zh:
[实际批量页](https://www.pokecut.com/batch-edit)接受JPEG/JPG/PNG/WebP/BMP，说明最多50图。上传同目标图片集，选增强、去背景、换背景或裁切/改尺寸，处理后整体检查并打包下载；重点图可进Unlimited Canvas进一步调光、修饰或生成场景。

增强模式含Standard、Portrait、Text，抠图模式含General、Head & Face、Text，背景可纯色/自定义色、上传图或模板。这些是流程描述，不保证符合平台政策，也不证明“最多少30%准备时间”已实测。大交付前应对照困难边缘、文字/商品色，抽检每类源图，本文未上传或处理批次。

sections.title_en: Current website tiers and viewed GBP prices
sections.title_zh: 当前网页分档及本次英镑报价
sections.en:
The normal browser annual cards showed Ultra £65.99/year (£5.50/month equivalent), Pro £51.99 (£4.33 equivalent) and SE £29.99 (£2.50 equivalent). Selecting Monthly showed £13.99/£9.99/£5.99, with an SE £0.99 first-month offer in that view. These are localized offers, not universal prices or guaranteed renewal terms; taxes/eligibility and actual charge need checkout confirmation.

Ultra/Pro/SE list 1,500/800/300 credits per month. Pro/Ultra advertise unlimited standard removal/enhancement/extension tools, whereas SE and Free use credits for them. This does not make advanced models or every generation unlimited. Pro/SE annual cards promote a three-day trial, and the monthly SE promotion is a different billing offer. Do not merge promotional access with normal recurring price.
sections.zh:
正常浏览器年付卡片为Ultra每年£65.99（折合每月£5.50）、Pro £51.99（£4.33）、SE £29.99（£2.50）。切月付显示£13.99/£9.99/£5.99，SE该视图首月£0.99。这是本地化报价，不是统一价格或续费保证；税费/资格及扣款需结账确认。

Ultra/Pro/SE每月1,500/800/300点，Pro/Ultra对指定标准移除/增强/扩图工具宣传无限，SE及Free则耗点，不代表高级模型或所有生成无限。Pro/SE年付卡片宣传三天试用，月付SE首月优惠是另一账单方案，不能与常规续费合并。

sections.title_en: Successful operations, unchanged repeats and nonexpiry
sections.title_zh: 成功操作、未变重复及永久点数
sections.en:
The [website payment terms effective October 12,2026](https://www.pokecut.com/payment-terms) deduct credits after successful processing, with multiple features on one image potentially causing multiple deductions. Re-saving/reprocessing an unchanged image does not deduct again under that clause. Each feature has its own rate, so one credit is not a universal finished-image unit.

Recurring unused credits do not roll over; the FAQ says they refresh on the first of each month while also describing weekly/monthly allocations. Exact current plan timing should be confirmed. Purchased one-time credits do not expire. Upgrading starts immediately and carries remaining old-plan credits under stated end-of-cycle conditions; this differs from PicWish’s current upgrade-expiry wording and should not be merged across products. Credit packs and over-limit unit rates were not numerically quoted here.
sections.zh:
[2026年10月12日生效网页付款条款](https://www.pokecut.com/payment-terms)规定成功处理后扣点，同图使用多个功能可能多次扣，未变图片重新保存/处理按该条不再扣。每个功能费率不同，1点不等于统一成图单位。

循环未用点不结转，FAQ说每月1日刷新但又描述周/月分配，当前具体时间需确认。一次性购买点永久有效；升级立即生效，按所述账期条件保留旧点，这与PicWish当前升级旧点失效不同，不能跨产品合并。本文未取得点包及超额单价的具体数值。

sections.title_en: Website purchases do not buy app benefits
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ explicitly says web Premium/credits cannot currently be used in the Pokecut app. Payment terms apply to the website, excluding Apple/Google app purchases. Verify the account and channel before buying for a mobile workflow. Cancel automatic renewal in My Order; benefits continue to the next billing date instead of disappearing immediately.

The refund wording is narrow: normally within one day of payment, with a valid reason, proportional to remaining credits and less platform processing costs; exceptional cases are reviewed. This is not an unconditional full refund. Subscriptions auto-renew; invalid payment may suspend paid access and renewal price changes are notified under the terms. No purchase, app entitlement, cancellation or refund was tested.
sections.zh:
价格FAQ明确网页Premium/点数目前不能用于Pokecut App，付款条款适用于网站而排除Apple/Google购买。移动流程购买前应核对账户和渠道。My Order可取消自动续费，权益保留到下账单日，不是立即消失。

退款条件较窄：通常付款1日内、有有效理由，按剩余点比例退并由用户承担平台手续费，例外个案审查，并非无条件全退。订阅自动续费，无效付款可暂停权益，续费调价按条款通知。未测试购买、App权益、取消或退款。

sections.title_en: Check the applicable web and app agreement separately
sections.title_zh: 网页与App适用协议分别核对
sections.en:
The linked [Terms of Use](https://www.pokecut.com/term-of-use) use app-oriented language, a limited revocable license, provider-content restrictions and an operational license to user content. Their storage clause does not promise permanent storage absent written agreement. The newer payment terms expressly distinguish website from app. Do not treat an “unlimited cloud storage” card as a backup guarantee or assume app-specific content clauses resolve every web/client-output right.

For commercial work, confirm the governing contract and rights to source photos, licensed assets and generated outputs. No proprietary platform code rights or open-source distribution grant were established beyond limited service access. Exact retention/deletion, private-photo processing, advanced-model rates and output fidelity remain unverified. No editor/AI, cloud persistence, commercial clearance or permission/recovery test was executed.
sections.zh:
链接[使用条款](https://www.pokecut.com/term-of-use)采用App语境，有限可撤销许可、提供方内容限制及用户内容运营许可，存储章节无书面约定不保证永久保存；较新付款条款又明确网站与App不同。不能把“无限云存储”卡片当备份保证，也不能用App内容条款解决所有网页/客户输出权。

商业项目应明确适用合同及源照片、授权素材、生成结果权利。有限服务访问不提供平台源码或开源分发权。具体保留/删除、私有照片处理、高级模型费率及保真仍未核实。未执行编辑/AI、云持久化、商用清权或权限/恢复测试。
